tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events

steps.what: Clarify the economics teacher's actual contribution, timing and audience with the campus or community event organiser.
Write and check the actual participation confirmation in {EMAIL}, including the agreed contribution, timing and organiser recipient.
Send that exact checked participation confirmation to the organiser through {EMAIL}.
inputs: Exact confirmation and recipient checked in s2

steps.what: Participate in campus and community events, contributing economics expertise and responding to people in the actual event setting.

tasks.design: No saving established for this event participation episode. Separate the real confirmation writing and send from organiser dialogue and participation. Existing email already handles the short confirmation; no new administrative report or automated attendance inference is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: The contribution and engagement depend on actual people and the event.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability demonstrated beyond existing communication tools.
tasks.still_hard: Adapting a contribution to the audience in the moment.
tasks.human_edge: Economics expertise and real community relationships.

ambition.what: Continue the agreed campus and community contribution.

evidence.claim: Personal event participation remains human; existing email can already carry a short confirmation.

assumptions: E1 task allocation for an invited event with a real confirmation, not a measured baseline. The confirmation is split before concluding zero; no duplicated entry is assumed.

s2 is ordinary completed-message writing and checking, supplying the requested exact-version send gate without added self-approval work. Changes to contribution, timing or recipient require recheck. Send remains fully retained.

This episode requires no formal post-event report or record; none is invented. Any actual presentation preparation is part of the real contribution and yields no saving here. Organisers' planning and audience labour have no claimed saving.
research_questions: Is any actual repeat preparation work present beyond the fully retained contribution?

already_counted.description: Organiser clarification, actual confirmation writing/checking, send and participation remain unchanged.

approvals.approved_version: Exact participation confirmation and organiser recipient checked in s2

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All separately examined dialogue, message and participation work stays at 100%; no demonstrated new reducible work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Find the student organisation's actual request, prior agreed actions and relevant university guidance in {DOCS} and {EMAIL}.
outputs: Relevant source context and missing information

steps.what: Ask the student organisation's representatives about their actual goals, constraints and unresolved questions.
outputs: Actual clarified student goals and constraints

steps.what: Act as advisers to student organizations by discussing realistic options, applying economics expertise and agreeing useful next steps without taking over the students' decisions.
outputs: Actual advice and agreed next steps or unresolved decisions

steps.what: Write the actual follow-up advice and agreed actions in {DOCS}, checking the completed note and intended student recipients against the discussion.
inputs: Actual advice and decisions from s3
outputs: Checked final advice note and recipients

steps.what: Save the exact checked advice note in the authorised organisation folder {DOCS}.
inputs: Exact final note checked in s4

steps.what: Send the exact checked follow-up note to the verified student representatives through {EMAIL}.

tasks.design: Configure a saved organisation folder view and an existing note template in {DOCS}. Reuse organisation identifiers and fixed headings only. The teacher still elicits the situation, gives all substantive advice and writes the actual discussion outcome.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prior actions and guidance are repeatedly located, and organisation details recopied into follow-up notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document filters and reusable note fields.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding what the students need and giving advice they can act on.
tasks.human_edge: Trusted dialogue and contextual academic judgment.

ambition.what: Support the existing student organisation advisory role.

tasks.altitude: Advisory responsibility remains with the teacher; student decisions remain with students.

evidence.claim: Native document filters and fixed note fields can reduce repeated retrieval and administrative entry while substantive advice remains human.

assumptions: Conditional E1 workload with an actual written follow-up; shares are not a measured baseline. If records are already easy to find and fields reused, saving is zero.

Students produce the actual request and existing organisation documents. Missing goals or decisions are obtained in s2 and s3; no structured meeting output or free transcript is assumed. s4 actually writes new advice, with only 10% fixed-field reduction.
s4 includes ordinary final note and recipient checking after content exists, not a new approval ceremony. The exact version gates both fully retained save and send. Changes invalidate the checks.
No student grant, budget, admission or event authorisation is made by this workflow. It supports advice and actual follow-up only, with no other-role or student labour saving claimed.
unknowns: Actual follow-up writing and repeated fields
research_questions: Which real follow-up fields are repeatedly copied and which are newly reasoned advice?

already_counted.description: Source inspection, full student dialogue and advice, substantive follow-up writing/checks, save and send remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain organisation folder access, filters and fixed note fields.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final advice note checked in s4
Exact advice note and student recipients checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10 x 40% retrieval plus 23 x 10% fixed-field writing reduction = 6.3 gross points less 0.8 upkeep. All advice, substantive prose and action tails remain counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The economics teacher retains personal contribution and student advice.
role.ambitious_version: A teacher with less repeated context retrieval who remains personally engaged with students and the community.
